# build-account-management

Account Management (AM / PM) website build skills: kickoff, welcome and weekly client emails, Kickoff Call brief and processing, end-of-week handoff checks, go-live email, case study and project close-out.

Installing it also installs: [`build-shared`](../shared/README.md).

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`new-build-kickoff`](../../../skills/new-build-kickoff/SKILL.md) | Day 1 kickoff for a new WISE website build. |
| [`welcome-email`](../../../skills/welcome-email/SKILL.md) | Writes the Week 1 welcome email a WISE Account Manager sends a new website client right after kickoff. |
| [`kickoff-call-brief`](../../../skills/kickoff-call-brief/SKILL.md) | Writes the brief an account manager reads before a new website client's Kickoff Call, once the Day 1 kickoff files already exist. |
| [`kickoff-call-processing`](../../../skills/kickoff-call-processing/SKILL.md) | Turns a new-build client's Kickoff Call (orientation call) transcript into the Blueprint inputs. |
| [`week-1-client-email`](../../../skills/week-1-client-email/SKILL.md) | Drafts the end-of-Week-1 email a WISE Account Manager sends a website client with the homepage design (at least one, sometimes more) and the homepage copy. |
| [`week-1-handoff-check`](../../../skills/week-1-handoff-check/SKILL.md) | Go/no-go check that a website build's Week 1 is finished before Week 2. |
| [`week-2-client-email`](../../../skills/week-2-client-email/SKILL.md) | Drafts the end-of-Week-2 email a WISE AM sends a website client with the Growth Blueprint deck and the sitemap page content. |
| [`week-2-handoff-check`](../../../skills/week-2-handoff-check/SKILL.md) | Go/no-go gate on a website build's Week 2 deliverables. |
| [`week-5-client-email`](../../../skills/week-5-client-email/SKILL.md) | Drafts the Week 5 email a WISE Account Manager sends a client with the staging site link for their last review before launch, under 150 words, what to check (facts, names, contact details), how to... |
| [`week-5-handoff-check`](../../../skills/week-5-handoff-check/SKILL.md) | Runs the go/no-go final sweep ending a website build's Week 5 and, on GO, writes the all good to go message to dev. |
| [`week-6-go-live-email`](../../../skills/week-6-go-live-email/SKILL.md) | Drafts the Week 6 go-live confirmation email a WISE PM sends a website client when the new site is ready to launch. |
| [`case-study`](../../../skills/case-study/SKILL.md) | Writes the WISE case study narrative and the showcase design brief for a launched website build, from the build's own files. |
| [`project-close-out`](../../../skills/project-close-out/SKILL.md) | Writes a launched website build's close-out package from the build's own files - the internal project summary with a Build complete table and outstanding items, the client transition email that mov... |

The skills themselves live in [`skills/`](../../../skills/). This folder only shows which ones belong to this plugin.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add tidycatc132/claude-skills
/plugin install build-account-management@wise-skills
```
